thread:
emma: Quick sync — I want to propose a compact pilot slice for the Optimize toolkit. Goal: validate batching + cache + quantization combos on a constrained workload (mobile & webhook paths). Looking for scope, acceptance gates, and ops constraints. :wave:

raj: +1. Need clear acceptance criteria. I suggest: p50 latency < 120ms for mobile path, token-cost reduction >= 12% vs baseline for webhook path, and no more than 1.5% quality regression on eval set.

oliver: Ops check — we can provision a small Dedicated pool for 2 weeks but autoscale/playback rules need to be explicit. Also request for per-route fallback to hosted models if capacity hits 85%.

emma: Good call. For pilot slice we should cap concurrency per-customer and limit burst to preserve other tenants. Proposed constraints: max_concurrency=8, burst_tokens=50k/day. Thoughts?

raj: Those caps look sane. Also add a canary period (48h) where we hold a rollback threshold: if eval drop >1.5% OR error rate increases by 0.4pp, automatic rollback.

soumya: For eval-triggered alerts: propose a 20-prompt smoke eval and a longer 200-prompt daily pass. Alert rules: immediate slack alert for smoke if >1 prompt fails, daily summary with diffs and examples. Keep the smoke set representative of mobile short-turn and webhook long-turn.

mike: Customer asks coming in from ACME & NovaPilot: they want per-route audit logs + ability to pin model variants if rollout causes problems. Also ask for a simple SLO doc to show them.

oliver: Autoscale suggestion (example):
```yaml
pilot_pool:
  gpus: 2
  max_instances: 6
  max_batch_size: 32
  cache_ttl_seconds: 120
  quant_profile: int8
```
We'll need to surface `cache_ttl_seconds` and `quant_profile` knobs in the console for pilot engineers.

emma: Nice. On scope: MVP features = batching policy presets, prefix cache toggle, quantization profiles UI, eval-smoke integration, canary rollbacks, per-route logging. Non-MVP: adaptive batching ML, cross-tenant caching, econometrics dashboard.

raj: Launch gates to sign off: 1) Latency & cost targets met across 3 representative rigs, 2) Eval pass with smoke set and daily checks in place, 3) Ops runbook + rollback automation tested, 4) Customer beta docs + onboarding checklist ready.

soumya: Small note on alerts: make sure alert messages include sample prompt+baseline vs new output diff. That helps investigate regressions quickly.

mike: For pilot customers: offer a 2-week technical concierge + weekly sync. If they opt-in, give them an opt-out button to revert to previous pinned model.

deploy-bot: infra:pilot-provision request #4321 created (ETA: 48h). Logs will be pushed to /redwood/pilot/1782468.

emma: Next steps: product to lock acceptance criteria + customer list by EOD Friday. Ops to confirm provisioning timeline and console knobs. Eng (soumya/raj) to draft eval smoke and rollback rules. I'll consolidate and spin up a short PRD. :memo:
